description: This file contains validation functions and inference logic for a YOLO-based object detection model, including coordinate conversion, batch processing, and evaluation metrics.

methods.name: xywh2xyxy
methods.description: Converts bounding box coordinates from center_x, center_y, width, height to x1, y1, x2, y2 format.

methods.name: process_batch
methods.description: Processes detection and label batches to determine correct predictions at various IoU thresholds.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs model evaluation on validation data, computing metrics like mAP, precision, recall, and F1 score.
